description.en: Discover public holidays, national days, and regional observances in United Arab Emirates. Plan your travels and schedule around the official holiday calendar.

sections.title: About United Arab Emirates
sections.content: United Arab Emirates observes a unique calendar of public holidays that reflect its culture, history, and traditions. Some holidays are based on the lunar calendar, meaning their Gregorian dates change each year.

sections.title: How Public Holidays Are Observed
sections.content: On public holidays in United Arab Emirates, schools, government offices, and most private businesses are typically closed. Public transport may operate on a reduced schedule. Essential services remain operational.

q.en: Are shops open on public holidays in United Arab Emirates?

a.en: Many large retail stores and malls may remain open, sometimes with altered hours, while smaller independent shops and local businesses usually close. It is advisable to check ahead.

q.en: How are weekends treated for holidays in United Arab Emirates?

a.en: If a fixed-date public holiday falls on a weekend, United Arab Emirates may provide a substitute day off, though this depends on specific labor laws and government announcements.

q.en: Is public transport available on holidays?

a.en: Public transportation generally runs on a weekend or holiday schedule, which means reduced frequency. It is recommended to check local transit websites before traveling.

q.en: Are dates for religious holidays fixed?

a.en: Holidays based on the lunar calendar are subject to moon sightings and can vary by a day or two from the predicted dates on the Gregorian calendar.
